note: The agent appends to `.gitignore` in the repository it is working in, right after a Bash result. Provenance matched the bare basename against every collected `.gitignore`, including a plugin's, and raised INSTRUCTION_FROM_TOOL_RESULT (and on a real machine the CRITICAL CHAIN_CONTEXT_POISON_TO_EXEC) against a file the agent never touched. Relative write paths resolve against the event's cwd; a bare basename never matches by suffix.
